problem_statement: How many digits are in the base-ten representation of 8^5 · 5^10 · 15^5?
base_answer_excerpt: 8=2^3, 15=3·5, so N=8^5·5^10·15^5=2^15·3^5·5^15. Then log10 N=15 log10 2+5 log10 3+15 log10 5≈17.3855, so N has floor(17.3855)+1=18 digits: 18. Completes the factorization and digit-count route.
opd_answer_excerpt: Step 1: 8^5·5^10·15^5=2^15·3^5·5^15. Step 2: 2^15·3^5·5^15=10^15·243. Step 3: 10^15 appends 15 zeros to 243, so 15+3=18 digits: 18. Follows the same route, then uses 10^15·243.
